area_corrections: Knob verdict stands: use the 0x803FA998 literal (one reader, 0x8017BE5C), not g_HIO.mAspectRatio. Corrections. (1) mDoLib_project has 35 DOL bl sites in 16 functions, not '21 callers', plus 4 REL relocations (ff, kantera, npc_ls1×2) and our REL. (2) The widened view->mAspect is 0x3FDA740D (fmuls single rounding), not 0x3FDA740E. (3) Confirmed that the Gecko's only 3D change is the 0x803FA998 line; all its other writes are HUD, menu or 2D, including the Painter ortho constants 0x803F7D68/6C, fade4 0x803FB77C/8C and wipeIn 0x803F89B8. (4) A full scan of the 415 RELs on the disc closes the stub-REL question: no REL has its own perspective or references g_HIO, and only ff, kantera and npc_ls1 call mDoLib_project. (5) 0x8020F518 (dMsg_mesgOutPos) does not need the wrapper (Y only). (6) The 2D pass's ortho is the box (-9,-21)-(650,503): 2D unit = 659/640 EFB px, centre ≈320.5. The 320-centred wrapper reproduces vanilla reticle placement (already ~3% inward). (7) The picto photo viewer (pictureDraw) and setUpRectangle draw under their own orthos; setUpRectangle shares the Painter's constants. (8) Dolphin icbi invalidates the JIT, so a runtime code rewrite from C is viable. (9) The file-select cloth is a ~90%×84% centred panel, not full-screen; the pause cloth overfills the screen. (10) With Dolphin aspect = Auto (hack off), the heuristic runs, and screens left at 1.28 (file select, the pause cloth) may flip the output to 4:3. Go should force 16:9 when it sets mode 2.
